---
title: "How to structure a page"
order: 1
---

This module demonstrates how to use Markdown and Quarto to structure and format training content. Each topic presents the Markdown syntax alongside the rendered result, so you can see how the code translates into the content participants will read.

Explore the examples, copy the snippets you need, and adapt them for your own training pages.

<br>

## In this module

- [**Topic 1 – Headings and text:**](/content/module-1/headings-and-text.qmd) Create headings and paragraphs, and apply basic text formatting.
- [**Topic 2 – Lists and tables:**](/content/module-1/lists-and-tables.qmd) Organise information using bulleted and numbered lists, and present information in tables.
- [**Topic 3 – Other content elements:**](/content/module-1/other-content-elements.qmd) Use code blocks, block quotes, horizontal rules, and collapsible sections to structure content.
